title: The exterior product over a field is associative
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: For a field k, X smooth over k and Y, Z, W locally of finite type over X, the lemma asserts that the product defined above satisfies (alpha . beta) . gamma = alpha . (beta . gamma) in CH_*(Y x_X Z x_X W) (statement lines 14341-14349). The proof is the field case of the same computation: Lemma labelled lemma-exterior-product-associative gives (alpha x beta) x gamma = alpha x (beta x gamma) in CH_*(Y x_k Z x_k W) (proof lines 14351-14353), then the closed immersions Delta_12, Delta_23 : X x_k X -> X x_k X x_k X are introduced with their bivariant classes Delta_12^!, Delta_23^!, which are recognised as the restrictions of Delta^! along pr_12 and pr_23 (proof lines 14355-14372). Both restrictions of Delta_12^! along Delta_23 and of Delta_23^! along Delta_12 are Delta^!, so Lemma labelled lemma-gysin-commutes gives Delta^! o Delta_12^! = Delta^! o Delta_23^! (proof lines 14374-14381). The conclusion is then the same six term chain of equalities, where the only non-obvious steps are the second and penultimate ones, which hold by Remark labelled remark-commuting-exterior (proof lines 14383-14400). Replacing the diagonal class by the two partial diagonal classes in the correct order is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
